title: The measured recall is pinned, and a split-spelled video is selected (R1002 slice 3)
body:
Slice 3 of `docs/plans/oracle/caption-split-aliases.md` — **OD-6 / R1002**.

`tests/fixtures/caption_variants.json` carries the **52** mangled spellings across BL-8's damage classes with the canonical each must reach, plus six never-match cases. It is a **reconstruction** and says so in its own `note`: BL-8 recorded the count, three named failures and the classes, but the list itself is in no commit, journal entry or run record. Filed as **BL-17** (LOW), proceeded on, under **OD-16**'s rule that a reconstruction declares itself.

**The table gains `airus elite` and loses `pro-rs`.** `air us` for `aorus` is the mishearing no join recovers — exactly the class R1002 leaves to data — and one form covers `air us elite`, `airus elite` and `air-us elite`. `pro-rs` folds onto the `pro rs` beside it after slice 1, so de-duplication drops it silently: a line the matcher can never use is worse than absent, because it **reads as coverage**.

**The blind tests corrected a vacuous test of mine.** The plan's selection case is a video titled `MSI MAG toma hawk MAX WIFI review`, described as "excluded before this plan". **It is not** — the shipped table carries `msi` as a vendor, so that title was already a title hit, and my `assert selection.reason == TITLE_HIT` would have passed against a completely unfixed matcher.

The blind author kept the title verbatim and moved the load-bearing assertion to `"MAG Tomahawk" in find_title_hits(...)` — red before the fix, green after — with the caveat stated in the docstring rather than hidden.

It also **observed all five plan-marked variants red before the fix** rather than trusting the marks, which is what OD-16 requires of a failing-today claim, and added a forward guard that no hyphenated shipped form is left dead by the fold — scoped to hyphenated forms only, since the joining rule's redundancies are deliberately kept.

958 passing.
